mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult (student_name, consult_date, school, grade_no, phone, inflow_route_no, content, created_at) VALUES (#{studentName}, #{consultDate}, #{school}, #{gradeNo}, #{phone}, #{inflowRouteNo}, #{content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
mapper.select: SELECT c.consult_no AS consultNo, c.student_name AS studentName, c.consult_date AS consultDate, c.school AS school, c.phone AS phone, c.content AS content, g.grade AS grade, i.inflow_route AS inflowRoute FROM CONSULT c JOIN grade_code g ON c.grade_no = g.grade_no JOIN inflow_route i ON c.inflow_route_no = i.inflow_route_no
